# Bike workshop policies at Café La Horquilla

Everything a customer needs to know before leaving a bicycle with us.

## Bookings and cancellations

A repair booking is free. Cancel or move your appointment at least 24 hours before the agreed
time and there is no charge. A late cancellation costs 50 pesos, and a dropped appointment costs
the full estimate.

## Storage

We keep a bicycle for 15 days after we tell you it is ready. After that the storage fee is
25 pesos per day, and we call once more before any other step.

## Groups and events

We host a Saturday ride that leaves the shop at 9:30. Groups of more than 8 people should write
to us a week ahead so we can arrange a mechanic and a second guide.

## Guarantee

Every repair carries a 90 day guarantee on the work. Parts carry the guarantee of their maker.
Bring the ticket; without it we can still look up the repair by the frame number.
